links.outcome: Stakeholder-reported barriers to adopting AI discharge prediction tool, including transparency
links.effect: Interviews of 24 stakeholders identified lack of awareness, lack of accuracy and trust, limited accessibility, and transparency as barriers to implementation. No quantitative results reported.
links.quote: The systematic assessment of the 48DPT implementation allowed us to describe facilitators and barriers to implementation such as lack of awareness, lack of accuracy and trust, limited accessibility, and transparency.

screen.reason: Empirical implementation science study evaluating barriers and facilitators among stakeholders using a deployed EHR-integrated 48-hour discharge prediction tool using RE-AIM and CFIR frameworks.
